other_failure_modes.name: Missing categorical feature specification in CatBoost
other_failure_modes.description: When using CatBoost with string or object columns, the indices or names of categorical features must be explicitly provided via the `cat_features` parameter. Failure to do so causes CatBoost to attempt to cast all features to floats, resulting in a runtime crash when encountering string values.

summary: The agent adopts a completely hands-off approach to data preparation, incorrectly assuming CatBoost will automatically handle raw string features without explicitly defining the `cat_features` argument. This leads to an immediate runtime crash when CatBoost attempts to cast string variables to floats. Furthermore, the agent fails to implement any validation split or feature engineering.
